title: fix(app-shell): reconsider a dismissed or revoked default permission set in the suggested-bindings panel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBBxSPB3for8PaPgERfFkDCM)_

Fixes #30199

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：权限建议面板里，被「忽略」或被「撤销」的默认权限集现在多一个「重新考虑」按钮。点了以后这一行回到待决定状态，重新出现「授予」「忽略」；重新打开本身不授予任何权限，要再点「授予」才生效。10 种语言和 Studio 中英文案都已补齐。
- 为什么改：服务端早就有 `POST /security/suggested-bindings/:id/reopen`，但界面从没调用它，管理员点了「暂不」之后只能找开发者调接口才能反悔。
- 风险与回滚：只动面板、它的客户端函数、两处调用方的文案表和语言包；没有服务端、REST 或 spec 改动。按钮只出现在已忽略/已撤销的行上，其他状态的行一字不变（有对照测试钉住）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` 里 `state === 'dismissed'` 的新按钮和 `act()` 的 `reopen` 分支；② `suggestedBindingsApi.ts` 的 `reopenSuggestedBinding`；③ `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` 的计数从 102 调到 103（新的德语提示引用了权限集名）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx`，预期 23 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`SuggestedBindingsPanel`**: a `dismissed` row (a declined suggestion or a revoked acceptance; the server records both as `dismissed`) drew only `strings.dismissedState(s)`. It now offers one action, Reconsider (`suggested-binding-reopen-SET`), which calls the re-open door. The server answers the row as `pending`, the panel puts that row in place, and it redraws with Accept and Dismiss (a re-opened `guest` row redraws as `guest`: Dismiss, still no Accept). A success toast says the suggestion is open again and that nothing is granted until it is accepted. A refusal goes through the same `catch` as Accept and Dismiss: the server's message as an error toast, then a re-read of the list.
- **Who sees it.** The same callers as Accept and Dismiss. The panel has no client-side gate of its own: a caller without `manage_metadata` is refused the list (403) and the panel renders nothing. The re-open door enforces the same authority (`assertDeploymentAuthority`).
- **`suggestedBindingsApi.reopenSuggestedBinding(id)`**, beside `dismissSuggestedBinding`: `POST …/security/suggested-bindings/:id/reopen`, through the same `parseOrThrow`, so a 404 (`SUGGESTION_NOT_FOUND`), 409 (`SUGGESTION_STATE`) or 501 (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, a security service without the optional member) is thrown with the server's code, status and message.
- **Strings.** `SuggestedBindingsStrings` gains `reopen`, `reopening` and `reopenedToast`. The panel has two string tables, and each gets the keys in the locales it already carries: `marketplace.suggestedBindings.*` in all ten locale packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh), and `engine.studio.access.suggestReopen` / `suggestReopening` / `suggestReopenedToast` in the studio namespace (en, zh, the only two it has). zh: 重新考虑 / 重新打开中… .
- **`de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`**: the German toast quotes the set („{{set}}“), one more matched pair, so the two counts move 102 → 103 with a comment line each, as earlier keys did.

## Why

Issue #30199. The door has existed since the re-open work on the server side (`reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion`, mounted in `packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts` and the runtime dispatcher), and its contract says a dismissed or revoked row returns to `pending` and grants nothing until accepted. The Console never called it.

## Tests

- `SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx` (real panel, real client, stubbed `fetch` answering the server's envelopes):
  - a dismissed or revoked row shows Reconsider and nothing else;
  - one click sends exactly one `POST …/sug_crm_reader/reopen`, no confirm; the row redraws as `pending` with Accept and Dismiss, the toast shows, `onResolved` gets the re-opened row;
  - dismiss → reconsider → accept sends dismiss, reopen, confirm, in that order, and ends `accepted`;
  - a re-opened guest row redraws as `guest`;
  - 409 (the set no longer declares `isDefault`), 404 (row gone; the re-read drops it) and 501 (no door; the dismissal stands) each show the server's message;
  - a caller refused the list (403) gets no panel and no Reconsider;
  - **CONTROL**: pending, guest, accepted and not-in-force rows offer no Reconsider and keep their states.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `{state === 'dismissed' && (` → `{false && (`): 7 failed / 16 passed, the 7 being every Reconsider pin; the controls stay green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Revoked rows get the action too (measured).** `reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion` refuses only a row whose `status` is not `dismissed`, and `dismissAudienceBindingSuggestion` writes `status: 'dismissed'` for both a decline and a revoke. Live: a revoke answered `dismissed`, and re-opening it answered `pending`, `deployment_decision: false`.
- **Fixture for the live check.** This repo ships no HotCRM. The one example with an `isDefault` set, `examples/app-showcase`'s `showcase_member_default`, boots as a baseline row (`confirmed`, `deployment_decision: false`), which this panel does not draw and the server will not dismiss. So the live leg used the closest fixture: on the showcase dev boot, a writable package `com.qa.reopen` made over the API, holding an object `reopen_note` (`public_read`) and an `isDefault` permission set `reopen_member_default` that grants read on it. Its suggestion lists as `pending`.
- **Hosted environments** still depend on #30192 (the `/security` doors reading the environment kernel). That is outside this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live: dismiss, reconsider, accept in Studio's Access pillar; an invited member then reads the object</summary>

Showcase dev boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`), Console via Vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, Playwright as admin in zh-CN at `/studio/com.qa.reopen/access`. The served panel source was checked to contain the new test id before the run. Screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/30199-shots/` (project files).

```
start: pending
after dismiss: dismissed · buttons: 重新考虑
after reconsider: pending · buttons: 授予,忽略
after accept: accepted · buttons: 撤销
200 POST /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings/sug_mw301423d3iszr6v/dismiss
200 POST /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings/sug_mw301423d3iszr6v/reopen
200 POST /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings/sug_mw301423d3iszr6v/confirm
```

Invited member (`invite-member` + `sign-up/email`): `GET /data/reopen_note` 403 before the accept, 200 after it. `GET /security/suggested-bindings` as the member: 403, so the member sees no panel.

API legs on the same boot: revoke → `dismissed`; reopen of the revoked row → `pending`, and the member still reads 403 (a re-open grants nothing); reopen of a pending row → 409 `SUGGESTION_STATE`; unknown id → 404 `SUGGESTION_NOT_FOUND`; the member calling reopen → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

</details>

<details><summary>Suites, type-check, lint, gates</summary>

All at head `ca174078`, each under `os-verify-lock` where it builds or tests.

- Panel + de quote-pairing: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` exit 0 (2 files, 32 passed).
- `@object-ui/i18n` whole suite + the panel: exit 0 (96 files, 1,466 passed, 13 skipped).
- Callers of the panel: the five `MarketplacePackagePage.*` test files that render it and `StudioDesignSurface.accessSegment-12452.test.tsx`: exit 0 (6 files, 36 passed).
- `pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` (both scripts echoed, `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `npx eslint` on the five touched app-shell files: exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 35 commands, each run and recorded; all 35 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "35 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The list is at `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/30199-gates-ran.list` (project files).
